accepted_design: Only source-valid bounded-window literal cue file affiliation; no global uniqueness/exact-identity claim.
Rank1 and scores/order retained; at most2 existing declarations reserved.
Selector clears incoming priority metadata before internal role annotation.
Real Flask regression checks GET route plus api_get_user return source and independent span verification, not a bare marker reference.

required_corrections.finding: split_whitespace misses ASCII named literal embedded in Chinese or qualified dot token
required_corrections.required_proof: case-preserving generic tokenization, Chinese-adjacent and qualified-name valid-source cases, no ontology aliases

required_corrections.finding: substring negative mutates text without source proof, so proves invalid source exclusion rather than token matching
required_corrections.required_proof: real indexed performance/format/superuser source decoy and ORM/User query no-support with byte-valid proof

required_corrections.finding: support-only priority can evict original required test/interface facets before earlier incidental candidates
required_corrections.required_proof: trusted intent-facet reservation and support tiers; final packed low-budget multi-facet source-valid assertions; no source proof/rank1/score/JSON/status weakening

required_corrections.finding: owner existence and signature inside hit alone do not validate owner/signature relation or non-empty signature
required_corrections.required_proof: owner includes actual nonempty signature; source-scope/version/doc guard maintained
